description: A phased, best-practice plan for moving to HelloBooks from another system. Pass `from` (quickbooks/xero/tally/zoho-books/wave/sage/excel/other), optional `country` (adds the right tax-setup step), `complexity` (low/medium/high — scales phase durations), and `includeHistory`. Returns 7 ordered phases (plan → export → clean & map → set up → import → reconcile → parallel run & cutover), each with concrete steps and a day-range, plus an estimated total timeline. Complements estimate_migration_effort (which quotes hours/price from an uploaded CSV). Guidance, not a binding plan.

country.description: ISO country code, for the tax-setup step.

includeHistory.description: Whether to migrate full transaction history (vs opening balances only). Default false.

name: migration_checklist
